### Tier 2: Boundary & Corner Cases (65 tests)
- **B1**: Empty email, malformed strings, SQL injection/XSS escaping, 500+ character strings, invalid phone formats.
- **B2**: Rapid dropdown toggling, Escape key dismissal, zero unread notifications, long email addresses, unknown route fallback.
- **B3**: 0-year experience fresher candidate, undefined expected salary, zero applies/shortlists division-by-zero safety, 0-skill candidate, string vs object education formats.
- **B4**: Quota deduction exceeding balance clamping to 0, 100% quota exhausted, 0 used quota, 0 deduction, empty webinars list.
- **B5**: Folder with 0 profiles (Program Manager), special characters in folder names (`C++ & Embedded (v2.0)`), empty recent searches, 0 matching jobs, long folder name truncation.
- **B6**: Extreme experience (40-60y) zero results, 500L CTC zero results, 25 keyword tags formatting, contradictory experience normalization, empty keywords handling.
- **B7**: 0 profiles matching prompt, Select All disabled on empty results, page index overflow clamping, malformed query params defaults, bulk actions disabled on empty selection.
- **B8**: Status Closed filtering (3 jobs), Drafts tab (0 drafts), non-existent job titles, multiple category union, regex search escaping.
- **B9**: Maybe stage (0 candidates) empty prompt, moving last candidate out of stage, status update idempotency, sub-status filtering, 1,000-character candidate comments.
- **B10**: Missing avatar initials fallback (`PM`), unverified phone dialer disablement, undefined bio fallback to headline, missing previous company, empty preferred locations.
- **B11**: Min experience > Max experience validation error, negative numbers clamping to 0, missing required fields flagging, special characters sanitization, zero candidate count warning.
- **B12**: Insufficient quota warning, audience cap at available quota, rapid double-click guard, opting out of AI boost, zero quota remaining button disablement.
- **B13**: Invalid job ID fallback, trailing slash normalization, case-insensitive paths, query parameter preservation, wildcard 404 fallback.
